aim_summary.goal: Add a 20 cm by 10 cm rounded-rectangular opening, 3 cm deep with 1 cm corner radii, at the lower back of the coffee machine.
preserve_targets: all coffee-machine geometry outside the local lower-back opening
aim_summary.expected_outcome: A localized rounded-rectangular opening at the lower rear provides space for a potential plug and main ON/OFF switch while unrelated geometry remains unchanged.

operations_plan.summary: Create the requested rounded-rectangular lower-back opening.

steps.description: Cut the rounded-rectangular profile into the lower rear enclosure to the requested extent.

expected_result.geometry: The lower back contains a rounded-rectangular opening with profile dimensions 20 cm by 10 cm, a depth or traversal extent of 3 cm, and 1 cm corner radii, positioned approximately equally from the bottom and sides.
expected_result.function: Provides a potential location for a plug and the main ON/OFF switch.
expected_result.behavior: Provides localized rear space for potential component placement or access.

validation_criteria.description: The opening has profile dimensions of 20 cm by 10 cm.
The opening has a depth or traversal extent of 3 cm.
The opening corners have a radius of 1 cm.
The opening is on the lower back and is approximately equally distanced from the bottom and sides.
The opening provides a potential location for a plug and the main ON/OFF switch.
The opening provides localized rear space suitable for potential component placement or access.
Geometry outside the local lower-back opening remains unchanged.
